concept: Earthy country-vet palette for Cortland Vet: a calm sage-green primary evokes pasture and gentle care, a warm barn-red accent nods to rural Illinois farmsteads, soft brown ink reads like aged leather and timber, all resting on creamy natural backgrounds for a rustic, trustworthy, gentle feel.
contrastNotes: All required ratios hold against bg #FBF7EF (L=0.933). ink #3A2E22 on bg = 12.3:1 (>=7). ink-soft #6B5844 on bg = 6.3:1 (>=4.5). white on primary #5A7355 = 5.2:1 (>=4.5). primary on bg = 4.9:1 (>=3). Bonus: white on accent #A8392E = 6.4:1 and accent on bg = 6.0:1, so the barn-red is safe for both text and white-on-button use; primary-dark #46593F gives ~7.6:1 white-on-button for hover/active states.
